body:
I noticed my hands instinctively move to wrap around the edges of the buoy ring, feeling its reassuring texture under my touch. A wave of calm washed over me as I leaned forward slightly, feeling the cool metal against my skin. My eyes darted around, but saw nothing else in need of protection except this tiny circle of safety. 

My next thought was simple yet powerful—protecting these people from whatever dangers lurked just beneath the surface was the most important thing right now. It would be easy for panic to set in if things didn't go as planned. But knowing it wasn’t their fault or mine, I focused on maintaining composure until they could take control again.
